fields.Name: Workflow Drafting
fields.Description: Turns a plain-English description of a repeatable process into a TaskGraphSpec — the steps and the dependencies between them — for the Create Workflow front door's "Describe it" entry. Returns a draft only; nothing is persisted until the author approves it on the canvas. Constrained to the agent names passed in, because a workflow referencing an agent that does not exist cannot be saved.
